meta.name: La granja
meta.description: La granja es una serie animada estadounidense producida por Steve Oedekerk (O Entertainment) para Nickelodeon, derivada de la película del mismo nombre. Es la segunda producción de O Entertainment y Nickelodeon derivada de una película después de Las aventuras de Jimmy Neutrón, el niño genio.

videos.title: The Good, The Bad & The Snotty
videos.overview: Para celebrar el cumpleaños de Otis, los animales engañan a Farmer para que vaya a Turnip-Con durante el fin de semana. Sin embargo, sus planes se vieron frustrados cuando ese mismo fin de semana el sobrino de Beady, Eugene, vino de visita.

videos.title: Escape from the Barnyard
videos.overview: Cuando se ve al granjero con lo que parece ser una parrilla, temen que planee comerse a los animales, por lo que escapan de la granja en un globo aerostático. Terminaron aterrizando en un campo de golf y lo confundieron con su nuevo paraíso.

videos.title: Cowman and Ratboy
videos.overview: Otis y Pip fingen ser los superhéroes Cowman y Ratboy, pero a los otros animales no les gustan sus payasadas. Afortunadamente, cuando Otis y Pip rescatan a los Pizza Guys de caer por un acantilado, los animales deciden unirse a ellos como superhéroes.

videos.title: Cow's Best Friend
videos.overview: Después de que Otis salva la vida de Duke alejándolo de un amplificador que cae, Duke comienza a volverse leal a Otis y se dedica a ayudarlo a hacer todo, pero Otis pronto se molesta cuando Duke se pasa de la raya.

videos.title: Chez Pig
videos.overview: Cuando los pasteles de trufa de Pig se convierten en un gran éxito en el corral, los animales deciden usarlos para venderlos a los humanos y ganar dinero, pero Pig renuncia cuando los animales comienzan a volverse codiciosos al tratar de ganar dinero, especialmente cuando llega una celebridad. para comprarles la receta del pastel.

videos.title: The Right Cow
videos.overview: Un mono de prueba espacial llamado Bingo aterriza en el corral. Los animales deciden dejarlo quedarse en el corral, pero Bingo no está satisfecho con el hecho de que Otis sea el líder, por lo que intenta deshacerse de Otis para convertirse en líder.

videos.title: Saving Mrs. Beady
videos.overview: Las bromas de Otis y la lección de manejo de Abby hacen que la Sra. Beady sea enviada a una institución mental. Sintiéndose culpables, los animales intentan rescatarla, para su consternación: el médico de la Sra. Beady quiere someterla a un trasplante de cerebro cuando cree que la Sra. Beady tiene un "cerebro loco" porque ve a los animales por la ventana.

videos.title: The Farmer Takes a Woman
videos.overview: Los animales no pueden tener fiestas los sábados por la noche porque el granjero llora constantemente por su esposa perdida. Otis le encuentra la novia perfecta para hacerlo sentir mejor, pero luego se dan cuenta de que ella está tratando de deshacerse de los animales de la granja echándolos del granero y apoderándose de él (obligando a los animales a quedarse en el gallinero que explota). debido a la capacidad máxima de los animales allí). Entonces visten a Pig como un hombre rico para alejar a la mujer del corral, pero Pig no mintió y se confesó, lo que hace que la mujer abandone al granjero. Al final, los animales tienen sus fiestas del sábado por la noche, Pig tiene el corazón roto (lo cual detiene después de unos minutos) y el granjero se fue de crucero con algunas mujeres.

videos.title: Hypno-A-Go-Go
videos.overview: Cuando Otis recibe un kit de hipnosis, accidentalmente se hipnotiza a sí mismo e intenta destruir al granjero cada vez que escucha el sonido de una campana. Ahora, los otros animales deben intentar proteger al granjero mientras intentan curar a Otis al mismo tiempo. Pero cada vez que Abby intenta evitar que Otis lastime al granjero, él piensa que ella lo está lastimando.

videos.title: Fowl Play
videos.overview: Sin ver a Peck por ninguna parte y con Freddy acostado sobre las plumas de Peck, los animales concluyen que Freddy se comió a Peck y planean prohibirle la entrada a Freddy al corral (Duke encierra a Freddy en un transportador de mascotas "perfumado" para atraer al conductor del camión de la tienda de mascotas para que Freddy pueda ser adoptado). Sin embargo, Otis está decidido a demostrar que Freddy es inocente.

videos.title: Barnyard Games
videos.overview: Otis se avergüenza cuando Abby lo vence repetidamente en los Juegos Olímpicos de Barnyard, por lo que intenta encontrar las debilidades de Abby y usarlas a su favor.

videos.title: War of the Pranks
videos.overview: Para vengarse de los insultos de Bessy, Otis intenta humillarla y avergonzarla, pero en cada intento, la broma resulta contraproducente. Posteriormente, Bessy le hace a Otis una broma real (y humillante) que los deja a él y a Pip cubiertos de miel y semillas.

videos.title: Lights! Camera! Moo!
videos.overview: Después de que Otis destruye accidentalmente la película de seguridad del granero, debe hacer una nueva, a la que le pone mucha acción y suspenso. Cuando los otros actores renuncian debido a las peligrosas acrobacias, Otis debe hacerlo solo y accidentalmente levanta la película. granero en un tornado. Al final, Bessy hace que la película de seguridad trate sobre las travesuras inseguras de Otis.

videos.title: Animal Farmers
videos.overview: Otis está emocionado porque su estrella favorita de la música country, Stumpity Joe, viene a la ciudad. Sin embargo, al intentar acelerar la recolección de la cosecha para que el granjero se vaya, accidentalmente lo hiere. Ahora, los animales deben hacerse cargo de toda la agricultura, o de lo contrario la granja puede quebrar. Pero varias cosas habían salido mal porque los animales no son verdaderos granjeros. Otis se ordeña arrugado con la máquina de leche, Bessy y Abby se niegan a usar la máquina de leche, Pig se come todo el maíz que recogieron (lo que lo hace engordar mucho) y Freddy se equivoca con la bebida energética para las gallinas poniendo dinamita. que, según él, es pimienta, lo que hace que los huevos que ponen las gallinas exploten al contacto.

videos.title: Raging Cow
videos.overview: Un erizo llamado Don Bling convence a Otis para pelear en un combate de lucha libre, pero resulta que todos los combates están arreglados, por lo que todos los oponentes de Otis pierden intencionalmente. Ahora, Abby, Pig y Pip deben intentar detener al erizo antes de que Otis pelee con alguien que realmente lo está intentando.

videos.title: The Great Sheep Escape
videos.overview: Cuando Duke intenta métodos locos para que las ovejas estén a salvo durante la temporada de osos, estas escapan y ahora Otis y Duke deben emprender un viaje a través del país para buscarlas antes de que escapen a Nueva Zelanda. Mientras tanto, Abby y Bessy visten a Pig, Freddy y Peck como ovejas. Pero le salió el tiro por la culata cuando el granjero pensó que Pig tenía "lanas nerviosas" cuando Pig accidentalmente dijo "Beeeee" y "Boooo" en lugar de "Baaaa".

videos.title: The Big Barnyard Broadcast
videos.overview: Después de que la Sra. Beady graba en video a Otis y la pandilla caminando y hablando, llama a una estación de noticias para demostrar que no está loca con la prueba de la cinta. Pero a los animales no les gusta nada. Ahora, intentan interrumpir la transmisión para que nadie vea su comportamiento antropomórfico cotidiano (y cumplir sus sueños de convertirse en famosas estrellas de televisión). Pero resultó contraproducente, cuando el camarógrafo recibió una llamada de la cadena diciendo que no estaban al aire, lo que llevó a la estación de noticias a cambiar el programa de televisión de los animales nuevamente a la transmisión. Así que ahora los animales deben robar la cinta para evitar que nadie vea sus travesuras.

videos.title: Dead Cow Walking
videos.overview: Cuando el veterinario pasa, ella menciona que su camioneta, la "Big Steer", no durará ni una semana. Sin embargo, Otis piensa erróneamente que el veterinario se refería a él y comienza a pensar que solo le queda una semana de vida. Para hacer sus necesidades, Otis intenta hacer todo lo que siempre ha soñado. Cuando regresa, los animales están felices de que se haya ido y los abandona. Cuando intentó saltar un cañón, cayó al fondo y se lastimó. Después de eso, los animales le piden disculpas por haberlo echado del corral.

videos.title: Otis Season
videos.overview: La Semana de Apreciación de los Alces de esta semana, por lo que Otis se disfraza de alce para poder recibir atención positiva de los humanos, pero su plan sale mal porque la semana terminó y ahora la TEMPORADA DE CAZA de Alces comienza hoy y ahora Snotty Boy y sus amigos están tratando de Cazarlo, y sus astas están pegadas a su cabeza. Entonces los animales montaron un alce robótico para asustar a Snotty Boy y alejarlo de Otis. Pero Snotty Boy accidentalmente sale a una calle muy transitada. Entonces Otis tiene que salvarlo de ser atropellado por un coche. Debido a su heroísmo, el condado ahora prohíbe la temporada de caza de alces y la convierte en la Semana de Apreciación de los Alces durante todo el año.

videos.title: Cows' Night Out
videos.overview: Al darse cuenta de lo tontos que son sus amigos: Freddy y Peck lo visten como un conejito en lugar de un monstruo para ahuyentar a los cuervos, Abby invitándolo al bingo y los hábitos de sus amigos en el bingo (Pip teclea ruidosamente en el teclado, Duke hace chirriar su juguete, Abby sorbiendo una bebida y Pig hurgando en su oreja), Otis los abandona y sale a pasar la noche en la ciudad, haciendo bromas con las Vacas de Jersey. Otis, lamentablemente, acaba siendo arrestado. Así que ahora sus amigos tienen que venir a sacarlo y evitar que el policía se lo lleve nuevamente.

videos.title: Big Top Barnyard
videos.overview: Otis' favorite circus is coming to town, but the gang accidentally injures the main lead. Feeling guilty, Otis offers to take over and along with his friends, but Abby is too afraid to do her part because of an incident that happened long ago: She had dropped her partner when trying to catch him. Abby refuses to do the part because of being afraid to drop Otis. But without Abby, the show ends up being a disaster

videos.title: Pigmalion
videos.overview: After the gang notices a distinctive birthmark on Pig's backside, Pig starts to believe that he is related to the royal Pampered Pigs. After training Pig, he becomes snobbish to his fellow companions.

videos.title: A Barn Day's Night
videos.overview: The animals become pop stars when Pip broadcasts one of their sessions, but soon their egos begin getting out of control and begins to put a damper on their friendship, which eventually causes a heartbroken Peck to quit.

videos.title: Meet the Ferrets
videos.overview: Freddy tries to hide his non-carnivore ways from his parents, who are invited to a birthday party at the farm, and Freddy tries to make sure they don't eat anybody, including Peck, while keeping it a secret to his friends.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Snottys
videos.overview: After Snotty Boy returns to torment the animals, Otis accidentally falls on him and becomes unconscious. Luckily, he's got a pulse and they decide to take him back to the Beady's, but Abby says that Mrs. Beady will blame them. Otis sends a disguised Pig over to the Beadys' as Snotty Boy so they don't get suspicious. But Pig enjoys being Snotty Boy so much that he decides to stay as him forever. Meanwhile, Snotty Boy gets amnesia and the animals realize that the only way to get Pig back is to turn Snotty Boy back to his old mean, obnoxious jerky self so Mrs. Beady will recognize him and because Snotty Boy is annoying them with his newly found kindness and sweetness.

videos.title: Snotty's New Pet
videos.overview: Otis' negligence causes Pip to get captured by Snotty Boy, who plans on feeding him to his new pet snake (who talks exactly like him).

videos.title: Home Sweet Hole
videos.overview: Pip's mousehole is destroyed by Otis accidentally. He moves in with the others, but they're all unused to each other's habits. After hearing a misunderstanding that is impossible to share a home with Pip, he runs away and finds a bee hive. Otis and his friends must search for him and return him to the barnyard.

videos.title: Otis' Mom
videos.overview: Otis discovers that he has the same bell as Bessy's long lost child, so Bessy believes that Otis is her child, so she starts treating him like a child and humiliates him and refuses to let him goof around and do pranks on Mrs. Beady.

videos.title: Club Otis
videos.overview: Abby discovers Otis' secret club, but the animals don't want a female member there so they pretend the club is very boring so Abby would leave. Soon, though, Abby discovers that Otis is faking, so she creates a club herself. Now everybody wants to join her club and Otis is left alone.

videos.title: The Chronicles of Barnia
videos.overview: When the gang gets caught by Snotty Boy in a game of "Dungeons and Barn Animals", they make Snotty believe he is in the mythical land of Barnia, and now the animals must force him out before he takes over the barn.

videos.title: Barnyard Idol
videos.overview: When it's discovered that Pig has a beautiful singing voice, Otis and the gang enter Pig in a singing competition to win the farmer a golden tractor. When Mrs. Beady loses, she is out to prove that Pig is a talking barnyard animal. Meanwhile, Pig's over-practicing causes him to lose his voice. So Otis tries to use lip synching but he doesn't know the lyrics in the song, so Pig is booed for singing terrible lyrics. In the end, Pig did win a prize (a tiny tote bag), but they couldn't keep the tractor they stole because it was illegal to steal a grand prize without approval of winning.

videos.title: The Haunting
videos.overview: A bunny's ghostly spirit possesses Pig after Otis builds a fun shack over a pet burial ground, and wants to take over the barnyard and reclaim the world.

videos.title: Brave Udders
videos.overview: Otis becomes afraid when he receives a letter from his childhood bully, Krauser Krebs, saying that he's coming to visit the barnyard, so his friends try to help him defend his fear of the bully.

videos.title: Otis' 11
videos.overview: Otis loses the saloon to Chubs Malone, head of the gopher underground, in a game of Fizzbin. Now, the gophers dominate the barn at night.

videos.title: Pecky Suave
videos.overview: Peck takes a fake potion to get enough courage to speak to his crush, Hannah, but he ends up being so confident that he challenges Root, a rooster much bigger than him, to a duel.

videos.title: Otis vs. Bigfoot
videos.overview: Bigfoot is sighted in the woods, and Otis decides to go hunting for him, but Abby finds him and brings him to the barnyard for his protection. Mrs. Beady, however, is out to capture Bigfoot and prove she is not crazy.

videos.title: Top Cow
videos.overview: Otis becomes the county's new crop dusting ace. An accident causes him to quit, however, and at the wrong moment: a large swarm of locusts is about to destroy the crops.

videos.title: School of Otis
videos.overview: Otis must take over teaching (in the stern of Bessy) after accidentally injuring Peck, the children's teacher. When he realizes that the kids learn boring things, he teaches the kids how to pull pranks. However, the kids develop an ultimate prank, which sends the barnyard silo to mid air, just when all of the animals are in there to hide from Duke, who appointed himself as new leader.

videos.title: Otis for Mayor
videos.overview: When Mrs. Beady tries to run for mayor, Otis decides to run for mayor against her to avoid Mrs. Beady from exposing them as talking animals. Their competition goes horribly out of control, however.

videos.title: Dummy and Dummier
videos.overview: When Freddy gets depressed over his lack of talent, Otis and the gang decide to make him take up ventriloquism. The dummy that they make, Mr. Jinx, comes alive, however, and tries to kill them. It turns out that a colony of termites has possessed Mr. Jinx to get revenge on them for using their tree to create Mr. Jinx.

videos.title: Some Like It Snotty
videos.overview: Otis and his friends dress up as girls because the bowling alley is open, but only girls get to go free. Their plan backfires when Snotty Boy and his friends try to take them out on a date. They are forced to agree when they realize that Abby and Bessy have put glue on their women's clothes so that they can't take them off and they can't throw them off because Pip removed the stink bomb from the purse to make room for himself. After one night, the other animals couldn't take it anymore, but Otis still continues to go out as a girl so he can get free things from Snotty Boy. Everything goes well until Otis realizes that Snotty Boy has engaged to him.

videos.title: Cowman: The Uddered Avenger (1)
videos.overview: When Otis as Cowman is assigned the task of guarding the Jurassic Corn Kernel at the county fair, Mertin Fargleman (voiced by Tom Kenny) wants to steal it to win the Gardening Award posing as Professor Twineyvines. When the town is impressed with Twineyvines and unimpressed with Cowman trying to save the Kernel from him, Twineyvines becomes the new protector. Immediately, Otis takes the kernel to protect it and is branded a thief and then chased by a mob. He then decides to stop Twineyvines when Abby finds Otis and Pip headed for Peru and says that Peck, Pig and Freddy have been kidnapped by Mrs. Beady, who they do not know is in line with Twineyvines. Now, Otis, Pip, Abby, Pig, Freddy and Peck must unite to defeat Fargleman, clear Cowman's name, and save the Jurassic Corn Kernel (mutated into a giant monster) from destroying the fair (even though the fair was already destroyed).

videos.title: Pig Amok
videos.overview: Pig returns to his birthplace to be married, but after Otis realizes that Pig's bride, Brunhilda, is cruel and bratty, he tries to stop the wedding by beating Pig in a contest.

videos.title: The Sun Cow
videos.overview: Otis' new Kobe cow neighbors begin to think that he's the reincarnation of the legendary Sun Cow when they discover Otis has a fifth udder (which was actually a bee sting). Otis is glad he has that status until he realizes that the cow neighbours actually serve "Sun Cows" at a steak restaurant and they're planning to do the same to Otis.

videos.title: Doggelganger
videos.overview: While Duke is at the vet after being sprayed by Pig’s skunk, a mischievous mutt named Baxter sneaks out and goes to the barnyard while disguised to look like Duke for what his life is.

videos.title: Save the Clams
videos.overview: Under Abby's request, Otis takes in a clam that she rescued from a nearby café. However, the clam is a rude and demanding house guest. It hogs the shower, Pig hanged up on a radio contest that Otis was calling to for temperatures in the barn, it takes over the barn at bedtime and, to make matters worse, it reproduces many party-going clams. Otis believes that Abby will get in trouble with the farmer once he finds out she is the one who brought all the clams into the farm and decides to relax while the other animals are stuck with the millions of clams. Soon they do not want to leave and instead bile Otis when he tells them to get out. Now, the animals must figure out how to calm them down.

videos.title: Cowdyshack
videos.overview: Otis uses Crazy Louie – a loopy groundskeeper at a high-end golf course and apparently his friend – to let him and the animals through the back gate and play a round. When Pig throws a club and accidentally hits Louie in the appendix, though, a guilt-ridden Otis decides to win the big golf tournament to get a new appendix.

videos.title: Adventures in Snotty Sitting
videos.overview: After the animals break the farmer's classic video game system, they need to make some quick cash to replace it. Seeing an ad to babysit, they dress up as British nannies and show up at the address on the ad. Only when Mrs. Beady answers the door do they realize they're babysitting Snotty Boy, but Snotty Boy wreaks havoc on them and the animals have to get the little terror fed, bathed and into bed before the Beadys get home and earn the money for babysitting.

videos.title: Wild Mike's Dance Party
videos.overview: Otis is bored of Abby's book club, so he releases Wild Mike from a cage so they can have a dance party, but things get out of control when Wild Mike accidentally escapes the barn and is captured by humans to use on a dancing TV show.

videos.title: Buyers Beware
videos.overview: When the farmer puts a sign that says "Welcome Buyers", the animals fear that he is selling the barn to other people, so whenever someone comes to the barn, they use tactics to scare them away. Then, though, they realize the Farmer's surname is Buyer and he is only having a family reunion. So they returned the Farmer's family to the barnyard just in time for the reunion.

videos.title: Anchor Cow
videos.overview: When news anchor Hilly Burford is crushed covering a giant cheese curd that Otis made, the animals fill in for him on the news. They turn out to be a huge hit and replace Hilly, but Otis doesn't want them to replace him so they try to convince Hilly to get back to his job.

videos.title: Abby and Veronica
videos.overview: Abby is excited that her cousin, Veronica, is coming to the barnyard for a visit, but it turns out Veronica, despite appearing to be nice on the outside, is actually using her beauty to manipulate the animals into doing things to please her.

videos.title: Bling My Barn
videos.overview: When Otis accidentally blows up the barn with an atom smasher he accidentally received in the mail, they audition for "Bling My Barn," a home improvement show that fixes up barns for deserving families. But when they dress up Pig as a baby, he discovers the perfect family they're competing against, he tries to warn the gang but they ignore him thinking he's throwing a tantrum, so he runs away forcing them on a wild goose chase to catch him. When they finally caught Pig, he shows them the perfect family, so they drop out of the contest and use the material from the farmer's house to rebuild the barn.

videos.title: Udderado
videos.overview: The animals turn the barnyard into a Wild West theme park to raise the Farmer's bail money (who got arrested because of Otis wearing a viking helmet and mooning a cop) and decide to hire an actor to play the bandit. Instead of an actor, unfortunately, a real bandit shows up to pillage the town. So Pig comes to Otis' rescue with unicorns from the unicorn theme park to stop the bandit from attacking the barnyard.

videos.title: Cupig
videos.overview: Pig writes a love letter to his favorite pastry treat, but Otis finds it and thinks Abby wrote it to him.

videos.title: Happy Animal Fun Time
videos.overview: In order to get out of going to a "Brianna Texicanna" concert with Abby so he and his friends can go bowling to beat a rival farm, Otis lies and says he needs to celebrate "Happy Animal Fun Time Day" in which everybody must stay home to celebrate. But Abby believes him and decides to cancel going to the concert and stay home to celebrate too. So Otis distracts her with the holiday's activities so that he can join with his friends at bowling and Abby doesn't see that he lied to her.

videos.title: Dream Birthday
videos.overview: The animals feel bad for the Farmer after seeing that everyone forgot his birthday, so they decide to throw him a party and tell him it's a dream, but the Farmer gets carried away. He does this by stealing a motorcycle from a gang of bikers and then believes that the motorcycle can fly so he takes the veterinarian with him. But he forgot that it doesn't and he and the veterinarian ends up falling to the ground below. So Otis hurries to save them before they fall to their death.

videos.title: Lord of the Beavers
videos.overview: When Otis injures himself, Pip temporarily takes over as the barn leader, and when he recovers, realizes that the others think Pip is a much better leader than Otis was. Insulted, Otis decides to leave the barnyard and be a leader where he's needed – with a den of beavers.

videos.title: Little Otis
videos.overview: Otis is too lazy to do chores around the barnyard so he creates a clone of himself to do the work for him. It turns out the clone is a much smaller version of him, and when Mrs. Beady ends up capturing the clone, she is set to take him to a TV show so she can prove that animals can talk.

videos.title: Kids in the City
videos.overview: When responsibility is thrust upon Otis to watch the three kids of the barnyard, Joey the calf, Macy the lamb, and Boyle the chick, after Abby and Bessy read story time, Otis loses them upon taking them around the big city when Otis and the gang had to remove a chip from Freddy's skin to keep Abby and Bessy from finding out where they are. So Otis and the gang stage a fake robbery to reunite with the kids after a cop finds them and about to take them to the station. But soon the kids call Abby & Bessy to pick them up. On the way back to the barnyard in a helicopter, Bessy tells them about Otis being a lair and after each line, she punches Otis and with him asking for a parachute to bail the helicopter.

videos.title: Snotty and Snottier
videos.overview: When Snotty Boy's cousin Bernard stays at the Beady house and torments Snotty, he escapes and tries to seek refuge in the barnyard, so the animals must help Snotty to defeat Bernard so then he could leave.

videos.title: Paging Dr. Filly
videos.overview: The animals call Dr. Filly to settle a recent persistent argument between Freddy and Peck, but instead of making things better, Dr. Filly seems to make it worse when other animals begin disliking each other. They were almost going to leave (except Bessy) until Otis reveals that "Dr. Filly" is an imposter donkey named Chip who likes to impersonate Dr. Filly.

videos.title: Barnyards and Broomsticks
videos.overview: When the animals go on a camping trip, Pip tells a scary campfire story about a witch. When they get lost and find an old woman's house with tons of sweets, Otis fears that this woman is indeed the witch from Pip's story.

videos.title: The Barn Buddy
videos.overview: The animals buy a security system called The Barn Buddy (voiced by Gilbert Gottfried) for the barnyard, but it turns out that the system is doing more harm than good.

videos.title: Iron Otis
videos.overview: After Freddy's recipe for a tofrooster that is going to be cooked on the show, things get worse when Chef Big Bones (voiced by Jim Cummings) insists on using a real rooster, and captures Peck, so Otis disguises himself as a chef to save Peck from being cooked.

videos.title: Too Good to be Glue
videos.overview: When Pig cooks up what appears to be permanent glue, the animals try to sell the glue to make money. They soon realize that the glue explodes two hours after it is applied and must find a way to get rid of it safely. When they found all the glue from all the buyers, they realized they sold 500 pounds of glue to city hall so that the town can use it to patch the town's cracked manure tank. So the animals race to dispose the manure tank before it floods the town with manure.

videos.title: Everett's Treasure
videos.overview: The animals find an old safe in the barn that belonged to Everett's former owner Nebraska Schwartz. Everett doesn't remember the lock combination to open the safe, so Otis helps Everett recreate past memories of Everett's adventures with Nebraska Schwartz to help Everett recall the number.

videos.title: King Cud
videos.overview: Otis is knocked out and wakes believing that he is King Cudenhotep. The only way for him to get back to normal before the farmer comes back is if someone knocks him in the head again, but Otis has beaver guards that prevent others from getting too close to him. When they finally turn Otis back to normal, the farmer see them but get hit on the head believes he is Ben Franklin.

videos.title: Free Schmoozy
videos.overview: The animals liberate a show whale from a water show at a fair, but Otis has a lot more to go when the animals are being constantly eaten by this whale.

videos.title: Man's Best Fiend
videos.overview: Duke wants a playmate, but no other animal wants to play with him, so the animals convince the farmer to get Duke a playmate. Unfortunately for Duke, the farmer brings Duke's arch-rival Baxter back to the farm, and Baxter causes trouble with the farmer while blaming everything on Duke, getting Duke in trouble and being put in the barn with the other animals. They try to stop Baxter but the farmer scolds them for hurting him. So they dress Otis as a bear so that Baxter pushes the farmer to it and get Baxter in trouble. The plan works but Duke accidentally attacks a real bear instead because Otis was late on cue.

videos.title: Fumblebums
videos.overview: The animals must stand in for injured football players in a game and the coach’s mother to like him after becoming the mascots for the team.

videos.title: Endangered Liaisons
videos.overview: The animals claim the farm as a protected habitat to prevent a wreck crew from tearing it down and disguise Freddy as a spotted three-toed ferret. They then realize that this species is real, and a real female spotted ferret is shipped to the barnyard and Freddy falls in love with her. Sadly, the animals realize that female spotted ferrets eat male spotted ferrets when they marry, so the gang must get rid of her. Freddy is then heartbroken after his friends stop the wedding because he lost his one true love.

videos.title: Back at the Booyard
videos.overview: n a bid to collect the most Halloween candy and win a prize, Otis tops off the animals' trick-or-treat candy with a handful of candy from a hollow tree that legend says belongs to Hockey Mask Bob who always gets his candy stolen and vows to return for revenge and reclaim his candy.

videos.title: Mr. Wiggleplix
videos.overview: Pig has been hanging out with his imaginary friend, Mr. Wiggleplix, for weeks and it drives the other animals crazy. Then one day, Pig claims that Otis killed Mr. Wiggleplix so Otis has to dress up as Mr. Wiggleplix for Pig to feel better. Things take a turn for the worst when Otis says he is leaving for a magical land but Pig believes it and wants to go with him. All of the sudden, the real Mr. Wiggleplix comes alive and stops Otis from impersonating him.

videos.title: Chain Gang
videos.overview: The animals get arrested when they are mistakened by the police for bandits disguised in animal costumes. Chained together, they try to escape so that they can use a computer to find the real thieves. But when they do catch the real thieves, the police says due to budget cuts, they aren't any keys to free them from their chain, so now they're stuck chained together

videos.title: It's an Udderful Life
videos.overview: Otis convinces his college buddies Donner and Blitzen to stop by the barnyard on Christmas Eve. During the visit, Otis accidentally gives Santa a cup belonging to Freddy, who is sick. When Santa comes down with Ferret Fever and can't finish his rounds in the county, which turns out to be his last stop on his Christmas Eve rounds, then Otis and the animals vow to make toys and deliver them by midnight to save Christmas. Meanwhile, Snotty Boy, not knowing he’s on the naughty list, really wants a Red Rider BB Taser that Santa doesn't bring him every year. So he sets a trap for Santa to make sure he brought his present.

videos.title: Get Bessy
videos.overview: Bessy is constantly rude towards the animals, even though she is barely seen. The animals wonder what she does when they don't see her and try to spy on her.

videos.title: A Beautiful Freddy
videos.overview: After Freddy gets struck by lightning, he becomes a genius and knows everything, so they get him to compete in a trivia show so they can win a million dollars. They realize that, unfortunately, Freddy's intelligence is only temporary and he becomes stupid again after a prolonged period of time. So the animals make an electrical system to make Freddy smart with each shock. But the problem is, every time a question is announced, he keeps getting dumb again and again. Frustrated that he keeps getting dumb, Freddy goes backstage and shocks himself at high velocity and dreams that he meets with Albert Einstein who gives him the answer to the final question which is actually incorrect so Freddy curses Albert Einstein for making him lose.

videos.title: RoboPeck
videos.overview: After Otis accidentally breaks up Peck's body with a hammer, he rebuilds Peck by adding robot parts to him so he can be a big help around the barnyard, but things go awry when Peck's circuits get overloaded after Otis puts pizza inside him and he goes out of control.

videos.title: Arcade of Doom
videos.overview: Otis and the gang go to an arcade so they can get tickets to buy a gaming console. Snotty Boy and his friends also want the console, however, so they have to compete to see who can get the most tickets first. When the animals get the game console, they end up giving it to a little boy who begs for the console and turns out to be a midget. The arcade is eventually destroyed when Pig accidentally shines his pocket mirror in a animatronic fox's eyes which had a 3rd setting called "Destroy Humans."

videos.title: Puppy Love
videos.overview: Duke is excited when his sister Stamps comes to visit, but is shocked when he realizes that Stamps is engaged to his arch-enemy, Baxter. However, the animals learn that Baxter is after Duke and Stamps' uncle's priceless dog bone collection. When they try to frame Baxter for chewing up a couch at his bachelor party (so that Stamps will dump him because she hates couch-chewers), Duke beats him to it and now scolded in front of Freddy and Peck. So at the altar, Duke tells Stamps about Baxter going after the dog bone collection, she dumps Baxter and he is launched in the field.

videos.title: Rodeotis
videos.overview: The farmer is in love with a woman named Branco Betsy who's a rodeo host and is interested in bull riders, so Otis pretends to be the farmer's bull so Branco Betsy would be impressed. At the rodeo, however, Otis meets Psycho, a much bigger bull, who injures him, so now the farmer has to ride Psycho, the big (and dangerous) bull.

videos.title: A Catfish Called Eddie
videos.overview: Otis' old best friend, Eddie comes to visit. Otis is mad because Eddie stole his product idea for pizza flavored gum. Eddie claims to have seen the error of his ways and wants new product ideas. Eddie starts hanging out with the gang and wins them over, except for Pip, who is suspicious. Pip then finds out that Eddie is just a sleazy, backstabbing jerk and reveals this to the gang. The gang decides to get rid of him by having the crows send Eddie flying off in a car made from cobs of corn from the field. Unfortunely, Eddie manages to make a bundle off the car, leaving the others in shock, except for Pig, who stupidly thinks Eddie won.

videos.title: Beady and the Beasts
videos.overview: Mrs. Beady has no choice but to move with the barnyard animals after being kicked out of her house and being mistreated by Mr. Beady's mother, Mother Beady.

videos.title: Mission: Save Bigfoot
videos.overview: The animals climb a mountain to reach Bigfoot's home after Bigfoot gets in an accident.

videos.title: Mrs. Beady Takes a Holiday
videos.overview: The animals successfully prank Mrs. Beady into taking a holiday. Now, they no longer have to worry about getting caught by her, but now Otis experiences withdrawal symptoms because he is no longer able to prank her.

videos.title: Clonedemonium
videos.overview: The clones Little Otis and Little Abby come back to visit the barnyard, but it becomes a problem because they never sleep so the animals couldn't sleep when they're here. In order to make them stop visiting, they try to create mini-clones of Pig, Pip, Freddy, and Peck so Little Otis and Little Abby can have friends. A problem arises when the owner of the Clone-a-torium plans to use the clones to expose the humans so they would know that animals can talk, and Otis and his friends must stop him from doing so.

videos.title: Hickory Dickory Donkey
videos.overview: When a beautiful she-donkey named Prunella takes an interest in Pip, Bessy suspects ulterior motives and follows them on their dates, causing the other animals to accuse her of being jealous.

videos.title: Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: A group of Canadian Crows want to steal the corn from the barnyard, but after repeated failed attempts, they decide to give the animals a fake treasure map to distract them from guarding the corn.

videos.title: Clown and Out
videos.overview: While trying to escape Snotty Boy, the animals run over Snotty's clown father. His dad survived, but has lost a lot of hilarity and Pig takes him into surgery. Otis disguises himself as Snotty's father to distract him while he recovers and becomes a cool dad to Snotty Boy. Only Snotty comes to love and admire Otis in a way he never did for his lame clown father. Otis has to think fast before he ruins this miserable family.

videos.title: Clan of the Cave Cow
videos.overview: An ancient cave cow comes to attack the barn animals! Meanwhile, scientists kidnap Otis, thinking he's really Cave Cow.

videos.title: Four Leaf Otis
videos.overview: The leprechaun steals the farmer's potatoes after Otis sprayed the potatoes, Otis and pals must stop him before the farmer goes bankrupt and the animals for less outlet. Unfortunately, also, the leprechaun turns Freddy and Peck into shamrocks and Pig into a corn beef sandwich head. Luckily, Otis gets an idea to cut out the middle man meaning to find the leprechaun's gold instead of catching him to surrender.

videos.title: Cop Cow
videos.overview: Otis and his friends become cops after another cop gets injured, and they try to solve a crime that is about stealing in a donut store. They find the suspects are Mrs. Beady, Snotty Boy and the Farmer. They try to interrogate them, but they're all innocent. They then learn that Pig is the real thief because he wore a burglar costume every time he goes to get donuts for his friends.

videos.title: Plucky and Me
videos.overview: Otis finds a giant chicken egg and decides to hatch it so they can have a fifth for polo. The giant chicken egg turns out to be that of a dinosaur, which proceeds to wreak havoc wherever it goes. The animals want to get rid of it, but Otis has paternal feelings and begs the animals to give him a chance. They relent, but things truly go awry when the dinosaur quickly grows a thousand times its size and falls in love with Mrs. Beady.

videos.title: Pig of the Mole People
videos.overview: Pig's mole subjects (from when he was Emperor of the Mole People for 45 minutes) have sought him out to return as their Emperor and defend them from Eric the Terrible, a verbally abusive worm and with the mole people around the barnyard, they can't get Pig to hang out with them because they keep shocking them when they are near Pig.

videos.title: Aliens!!!
videos.overview: In the series finale, Otis orders a satellite dish online in order to watch monkey boxing from Rio. Mrs. Beady sees this and believes that he is secretly signaling Aliens. Otis finds out and tries to prank Mrs. Beady with a fake alien invasion broadcast. This broadcast is sent to real aliens who are attracted to Earth and plan to conquer and destroy the planet. The animals must stop and stall them while they figure out their weakness.

videos.title: Barnyard
videos.overview: When the farmer's away, all the animals play, and sing, and dance. Eventually, though, someone has to step in and run things, a responsibility that ends up going to Otis, a carefree cow.
